approval_rules: Every new quiz item is inserted with a unique immutable ID and exactly four unambiguous answer choices.
Correct answer indexes and concise worked explanations live in Supabase private schema; never publish answer keys in this GitHub file.
New questions use the database available_from date default (tomorrow Europe/Berlin), preventing today's assigned tasks from changing.
Only complete five-step weekly cases with five private answer keys enter the rotating calendar; in-progress cases are pinned to prior attempts.
Update this file only after successful database query verification and CI regression tests. No rewards or user progress resets.
